title: Исход 35 — Exodus 35
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Моисей собрал все ___ израилетян и сказал им.
cases.translation: Moses assembled all the congregation of the Israelites and said to them.
cases.explain: Общество is the direct object of собрал (assembled); for a neuter inanimate noun the accusative equals the nominative → общество.

cases.sentence: Седьмой день святой — это суббота покоя, день, посвящённый ___.
cases.translation: The seventh day is holy — a Sabbath of rest, a day dedicated to the Lord.
cases.explain: Посвящённый (dedicated to) takes the dative to mark the one to whom the day is given → Господу.

cases.sentence: Не зажигайте в субботний день ___ в своих жилищах.
cases.translation: Do not kindle fire in your dwellings on the Sabbath day.
cases.explain: After the negated verb не зажигайте the object takes the genitive of negation → огня.

cases.sentence: Пусть всякий сделает Господу приношение ___, серебром и бронзой.
cases.translation: Let everyone make the Lord an offering of gold, silver, and bronze.
cases.explain: The material of the offering is expressed by the instrumental → золотом.

cases.sentence: Господь избрал Веселиила, сына Ури, внука Хура из ___ Иуды.
cases.translation: The Lord chose Bezalel, son of Uri, grandson of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from / of) takes the genitive → рода.

cases.translation: Do not kindle fire in your dwellings.
cases.explain: The preposition в meaning "in" a location takes the prepositional → жилищах (prepositional plural).

cases.sentence: Он может воплощать свои ___ в золоте, серебре и бронзе.
cases.translation: He can bring his designs to life in gold, silver, and bronze.
cases.explain: Замыслы is the direct object of воплощать (to realize); for an inanimate plural the accusative equals the nominative → замыслы.

cases.translation: The people of Israel departed from Moses.
cases.explain: Народ is the subject of разошёлся (departed), so it takes the nominative → народ.

reading.ru: Моисей собрал все общество израилетян и сказал им.
reading.question: Who assembled the whole congregation of Israel?
reading.explain: Moses assembled the whole congregation of the Israelites and spoke to them.

reading.ru: Всякий, кто станет в этот день заниматься делами, будет предан смерти.
reading.question: What is the penalty for working on the Sabbath?
reading.explain: Anyone who does work on the Sabbath day is to be put to death.

reading.ru: Не зажигайте в субботний день огня в своих жилищах.
reading.question: What are the people forbidden to do in their dwellings on the Sabbath?
reading.explain: They are told not to kindle any fire in their dwellings on the Sabbath day.

reading.ru: Господь избрал Веселиила, сына Ури, внука Хура из рода Иуды, и исполнил его Духом Божиим, мудростью, разумением, знанием и всяким мастерством.
reading.question: Whom did the Lord choose and fill with the Spirit of God?
reading.explain: The Lord chose Bezalel and filled him with the Spirit of God — with wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and all craftsmanship.

reading.ru: Все щедрые сердцем и мужчины, и женщины приходили и приносили разные золотые изделия – броши, серьги, перстни и подвески.
reading.question: What did the willing-hearted men and women bring?
options: Gold jewelry such as brooches, earrings, and rings
reading.correct: Gold jewelry such as brooches, earrings, and rings
reading.explain: Both men and women, willing of heart, brought various gold articles: brooches, earrings, signet rings, and pendants.

reading.ru: Женщины, которые умели прясть, по велению сердца пряли козью шерсть.
reading.question: What did the skilled women spin at the prompting of their heart?
reading.explain: The women who knew how to spin spun the goats' hair as their hearts moved them.
